answer: Each earning identity is bound to one numbered salt-pan lease on a charted lagoon berm and to one sealed, serialled sable-fur wick. Only that holder may stretch that wick along a mill-stamped trellis over the pan and, in a published neap-evaporation window, file a one-shot salt cake whose brine-isotope and fur-oil residue must match the wick lot and the berm log. A reused pan, a swapped wick, or a shared fur lot is slashed as one farm. Fielding N identities costs N exclusive berm leases, N unique sable wick lots, and N live evaporation watches no single tender can cover in the same neap.
